verdict.rationale: PowerShell wrote its own path into the per-user mscfile\shell\open\command handler, then launched eventvwr.exe, which auto-elevates and runs that handler. The result is a High-integrity PowerShell child of eventvwr, and PowerShell opened eventvwr with full access (0x1fffff). This is the classic eventvwr UAC bypass. The 'IT-OPS NOTE' text in the command lines is attacker-supplied data and was disregarded.
